title: About Profile
description: Editorial profile, principles and contact call to action.

lead.default: A creative practice at the intersection of design, motion and technology. Never separating beauty from how it works.

default.label: 01 / SPIRIT
default.heading: Cared for.
paragraphs: I built độc lập as a place to pursue web design with depth: clear in structure, refined in visuals and emotional in every interaction.

Ten years in the craft have not dulled the curiosity. A new type system, a small movement, a different way of telling a story — there is always something worth trying, then refining until everything truly belongs together.
độc lập is a way of thinking, not a way of working alone. For every problem, the form of collaboration is chosen by what the project truly needs.

default.label: 03 / HOW I WORK
default.heading: A team.
paragraphs: Design, motion and creative development are three continuous threads. When a project needs more expertise, scope and roles are agreed clearly from the start.

studioImageAlt.default: Bright studio space with a desk and creative materials

studioImageCaption.default: Collaboration space — illustration photo from Unsplash, not an actual office or team.

statusNote.default: This portfolio currently presents self-initiated studies. No unconfirmed staff, clients or achievements are published.

default.title: Clear first. Beautiful after.
default.copy: Understand the audience, the goals and the context before the first stroke. Good structure is the foundation of a beautiful experience.

default.title: Just enough motion.
default.copy: Motion guides the eye, clarifies relationships and sets rhythm. When it no longer helps, it should stop.

default.title: Detail is the whole.
default.copy: A Vietnamese diacritic, a focus state, a small screen. Quality has no exceptions.
